text_en: All my Ironclads are back safe and sound.
They told me you were the one who rescued them.
Lad, I take my helmet off to you. These soldiers seem strong on the outside, but inside they're still not ready for the challenges this world dishes out.
...Unlike you. You don't seem to be afraid of anything.
I'm very grateful that they're back.
You've earnt yourself something very special, I hope it isn't too difficult for you to carry. Wouldn't want it to seem like a punishment instead of a reward, now would we? Ahahaha!
